companies.name: QpiAI
companies.description: Bengaluru quantum-computing and AI startup, one of the companies selected under India's National Quantum Mission; it built the full-stack 'QpiAI-Indus' superconducting quantum computer and in August 2026 opened a quantum-chip (QPU) foundry on its 70,000 sq ft R&D campus in Jakkur. Raised a $32M Series A in 2025; also has entities in the US, Finland and Singapore.

companies.name: NewSpace Research & Technologies

companies.description: Bengaluru defence-tech startup building unmanned systems: swarm drones and a solar High Altitude Pseudo Satellite (HAPS) under the iDEX programme, with HAL as a partner on the full-scale HAPS. Founded 2017-18 (sources differ); reported a ~$73M Series B in 2024. Not to be confused with the ISRO PSU NewSpace India Ltd (NSIL), which is a separate entry.

coverageNotes: X10 gap-fill: all 15 critic-named companies placed, 52 Bengaluru offices (Table Space 27 centres, CoWrks 10, QpiAI 2, Fivetran 2, the rest 1 each). DUPLICATE CHECK: none of the 15 was already in the dataset under any name or alias (every raw file's names/aliases were searched); Table Space and CoWrks appear only as buildings/landlords inside other companies' offices (Snowflake's Coffee Day Square floor, Cashfree's and Twilio's CoWrks floors in RMZ Ecoworld). NewSpace Research & Technologies is a private defence startup and is NOT the ISRO PSU NewSpace India Ltd already in E10. CATEGORY CHANGE: CoWrks is MID_SIZE, not STARTUP - it was launched in 2016 by developer RMZ Corp and funded by its promoters (a 2019 plan to raise external equity is reported, no completed VC round), matching how WeWork India (Embassy-promoted) is classed elsewhere. Table Space stays STARTUP (founded 2017, $300M from Hillhouse in 2022; IPO only at DRHP stage, 908 employees nationally at Mar 2026). Tracxn stays STARTUP although listed since Oct 2022 (venture-funded, founded 2012), consistent with how listed ex-startups such as Swiggy are classed. FLEX OPERATORS: Table Space and CoWrks offices are the centres each operator lists on its own website (Table Space: 28 pages, two of them for the same MFAR Greenheart 2B building, merged); these buildings house client companies, not only the operator's staff. CoWrks' corporate-office address is reported inconsistently (PitchBook: Basavanagudi; CB Insights: The Millenia, Murphy Road) and is not recorded. PIN QUALITY: building-level for most offices; park centroids (confidence medium) where the tower is not named (several Table Space/CoWrks centres, Kapiva, Fivetran Ecoworld, SiMa.ai Bagmane Tech Park); locality/street-level pins for NewSpace (Sahakara Nagar), QpiAI Jakkur (Yashoda Nagar), Tracxn (17th Cross Road, HSR), Glean (Srinivagilu) and Table Space SOBHA 1 (St. Mark's Road). Two Table Space building identities are inferences, flagged in the evidence: 'Table Space Towers Whitefield' pinned at Kalyani Camellia (which Table Space bought in 2024) and 'Table Space Senate' pinned at OSM's IBC The Senate on Ulsoor Road; Zonasha Frontier is pinned at a nearby under-construction Zonasha building and is confidence low. UNCERTAINTIES: Glean's 26,000 sq ft July-2024 office is not named in launch coverage; the recorded address is the GLEIF legal/HQ address of its Indian entity (updated June 2026). Fivetran's GLEIF address (IndiQube Lakeside) likely predates its Feb-2025 Ecoworld India HQ and is kept as the registered office. Dozee's address comes from aggregators (PitchBook, Glassdoor, Bitscale) because its own site gives none. Skylark Drones' older IKP Eden (Koramangala) address was not recorded. EtherealX's test facility is in Cuddalore (Tamil Nadu) and is outside the map. No headcounts were entered: the figures found are company-wide, dated, or capacity statements (Fivetran 'nearly 300', Glean 150 targeting 450).
